Cruis'n World.name: Cruis'n World
Cruis'n World.summary: Features exclusive to the Nintendo 64 include a new Moon track, a few new modes and some of the vehicles being renamed.

Transformers - Beast Wars Metals 64.name: Transformers: Beast Wars Transmetals
Transformers - Beast Wars Metals 64.summary: Now, experience a Transformers battle you've never seen before! Take command of the Heroic Maximals and Evil Predicons as they struggle for supremacy! More powerful than ever, these cybertronian warriors can convert into 3 modes: beast, vehicle, and robot. Run, blast and transform your way to victory! Crush the competition with the awesome Ultra Blast attack!
